summary: No verifier defect found. Every graded report is compared in full (keys, ids, codes, row counts and order, null-ness, contributes as exact bool, numbers within 1e-6) against sealed goldens. Each NPM-4 rule and each shipped-code defect (gain 2800, missing half, no noise screen, epicentral distance, log interpolation, subtracted correction, largest channel, mean network value, no three-station minimum, per-recording station handling) has at least one fixture whose expected value changes when that rule is wrong. I found no constraint on output representation that the contract does not state.
checks_performed: Reconciled every packet-manifest entry with the files actually read. All 39 content files were opened, and no line was truncated. The manifest shows that tests/shipped/tools/ml_bulletin.py and environment/app/tools/ml_bulletin.py have the same hash, and reading both confirmed they are identical.

Traced compare() in tests/test_outputs.py:155-172. It compares top-level and per-event key sets exactly, requires str ids and codes to be equal, requires row counts and order to match, checks each number with |a-e| <= 1e-6 + 1e-9 (with null exact), and requires contributes to be an exact bool. This matches instruction.md:5 and NPM-4 6.1-6.2.

Hand-recomputed goldens against NPM-4 (static arithmetic, not an execution). gain ev000001 828HH: log10(5855.5/2*2080e-6)+3.0+0.36=4.1446 (expected 4.144597325). interpolation K0 at 127 km: 3.0+0.3*27/50 plus log amplitude = 3.66149 (expected 3.661492431). hypocentral hypo-12 NEAR at 13.4164 km: linear 1.82299 plus 0.71600 = 2.53899 (expected 2.538994027). off_table OFFA at 1000 km with the shipped log extrapolation: 5.5745-1.98297 = 3.59153 (expected 3.591532864). off_table OFFB at 5 km: 1.34+0.017033+0.1 = 1.457033 (expected 1.457033339). shared-null SITA pooled over three readings: (2*3.017033+1.017033)/3 = 2.350367 (expected 2.350366673).

Checked each shipped defect in environment/app/mlnet against a fixture it would fail. Gain 2800 shifts every magnitude by +0.129 (gain.jsonl). A missing halving shifts by +0.301 (half.jsonl). Epicentral distance fails hypo-12, where NEAR and OVER would stop contributing and ml would become null. Log interpolation fails interpolation.jsonl. A subtracted correction fails correction.jsonl (corrections from -1 to +1). The largest channel fails station_mean chan-1 CHB and CHC. A network mean fails median.jsonl. No three-station minimum fails fewer_than_three.jsonl.

Checked the noise screen at the boundary. In readings.jsonl line-1, LNA keeps 1.51 (>=1.5) and drops 1.49, and LNB keeps 300.5 and drops 2990 (<3000). An unscreened mean changes LNA by about 0.0029 and LNB by about 0.5, both far above the 1e-6 tolerance.

Checked shared-station semantics. Per-recording magnitudes fail rows 0 and 2 of shared-null (3.017 and 1.017 instead of 2.350). Counting recordings toward the three-station minimum gives shared-null a value where the expected ml is null. Counting recordings in the median gives 5.321 for ev000003 instead of 4.742 and 3.287 for ev000004 instead of 3.398. A mean of the two recordings' means differs from the pooled value in shared-null SITA.

Checked the contributing-station filter. Including off-table stations in the median gives (2.355+2.598)/2 = 2.476 for off_table off-near instead of 2.598. Using the epicentral distance to decide contribution fails off-deep, where OFFA at epi 0 km and depth 60 km contributes and OFFC at epi 599 km is 601.99 km away.

Checked the off-table instruction ('keep the present calculation', instruction.md:3) against the goldens. Expected off-table values use the shipped _segment and log-extrapolation path (attenuation.py:22-38) with NPM-4 gain, halving, hypocentral distance and added correction. Linear extrapolation (for example 4.79+0.0028*400 at 1000 km) or a clamp would be rejected, as the instruction requires.

Checked for proxy or stale grading paths. The verifier's own driver is installed with os.replace before any candidate code runs (test_outputs.py:52-63). The driver runs as nobody with python3 -I -S and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 on a neutral path (bulletin.json) from a fresh cwd (test_outputs.py:111-144). ROSTER pins the goldens' sha256 hashes and row counts (test_outputs.py:97-108). Candidate output is never used as the expected value.

Checked that every expected file is reachable. Each of the 17 ROSTER files is loaded by exactly one test function (test_outputs.py:180-266), and each load validates its bulletins against NPM-4 section 1 (test_outputs.py:66-94). The three special input classes are confined to their named files.

coverage_sweep.category: Map each required behavior to an assertion that fails when it is missing or reversed
coverage_sweep.reason: Rules 2.2 (gain, halving), 2.3, 3.1, 3.3, 4.1-4.3, 5.1-5.3 and 6.1-6.2, plus the off-table keep-present rule, each map to a named test whose goldens differ under the reversed rule, as traced in checks_performed.

coverage_sweep.category: Check the full core result, not just existence, keys or row count
coverage_sweep.reason: compare() checks every event and row value, including station ml for off-table rows and the null or number status of network ml.

coverage_sweep.category: Isolating case for each named domain rule, beyond general held-out variation
coverage_sweep.reason: Hand-built rows isolate the rules: half-1, line-1, hypo-12/hypo-60, chan-1/chan-2, shared-null/shared-median/shared-two, off-near/off-far/off-deep, solo, and the table_ends 10.01/599.99 cases. None of these depends on generated.jsonl alone.

The shipped code, each single-rule regression, per-recording station handling, recording-count thresholds, off-table inclusion, epicentral contribution, and linear extrapolation or clamping off-table all change at least one compared value by far more than 1e-6.

coverage_sweep.category: Contract-valid alternatives are accepted (formatting, ordering, implementation choice)
coverage_sweep.reason: JSON is parsed rather than compared as text, so object key order and whitespace are free. Numbers may be int or float within the tolerance, and hypot versus sqrt differences are far below tolerance. Strict and inclusive table-end comparisons agree because section 1 keeps inputs more than 1 m from 10 and 600 km. Strict and inclusive noise comparisons agree because inputs keep a 0.1% margin. List order and exact bools are enforced only where instruction.md:5 requires them.

coverage_sweep.category: Documented restrictions and lifecycle (driver must be identical and unchanged)
coverage_sweep.reason: The delivered driver bytes are captured before replacement and compared with the verifier's copy both before and after reduction. This matches instruction.md:1.

coverage_sweep.category: Proxy behavior, Oracle-specific representation, stale binaries, self-controlled comparisons
coverage_sweep.reason: Goldens are sealed and hash-pinned. The comparison never uses a candidate-controlled expected value. The driver is replaced with the verifier's copy. Bytecode writing is disabled and the run is isolated (-I -S). No Oracle-specific number formatting is required.

Every ROSTER file is loaded by a test. The per-file carrier assertion ensures the special classes actually occur in readings, off_table and shared_station. Each fixture satisfies section 1, so no fixture relies on the open inputs.
The reduction is a pure per-event function with no carried state across events. Station corrections are a static lookup.

coverage_sweep.category: Signed derived quantities: legal sign partitions discriminated
coverage_sweep.reason: Station corrections cover positive, zero and negative values including ±1.0, so a sign reversal of the correction is detected. Negative station magnitudes (for example -3.28, -2.14 and -1.24) are graded.

coverage_sweep.category: Semantic content versus native encoding or diagnostic output
coverage_sweep.reason: Only the parsed stdout JSON is graded. stderr, layout and package shape are not graded, and the unicode id in order.jsonl survives the json round trip.

interaction_sweep.case_or_path: hypo-12 NEAR (epi 6 km, depth 12 km, 13.42 km) and table_ends ev000005 P (epi 8 km, 10.06 km) contribute. off-deep OFFA (epi 0 km, 60 km) contributes, and OFFC (epi 599 km, 601.99 km) does not.

rules: NPM-4 1.2 two recordings per station / 5.2-5.3 counting stations
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: shared-null gives a null ml with 3 recordings and 2 stations. The pooled SITA value 2.3504 differs from both per-recording values and from the mean of the recording means. In shared_station ev000003 and ev000004, the median over recordings differs from the median over stations.

rules: Instruction: ungoverned value keeps the present calculation
NPM-4 2.2/3.1/4.2 still apply to the off-table station
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: OFFB at 5 km and OFFA at 1000 km use the shipped log extrapolation together with 2080 gain, halving, hypocentral distance and added correction. They are reported with contributes=false and are excluded from the median.

rules: NPM-4 4.3 mean rather than largest channel
interaction_sweep.case_or_path: In line-1 LNB, the screen drops the larger 2990 amplitude, so taking the largest channel and skipping the screen both give values far from the expected 2.7449.
off-deep has 3 recordings but only 1 contributor, so ml is null. off-near has 4 recordings and 3 contributors, so the median excludes the off-table OFFB. ev000007 has 0 contributors, so ml is null.
